description: Renewable Energy Schemes is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Bolton Metropolitan Borough Council. Areas of potential identified as a result of the 2010 Decentralised and Zero Carbon Energy Planning’ study. There is no information on existing renewable energy schemes. Coverage: Bolton Metropolitan Borough Council. The portal files it under the publisher Bolton Metropolitan Borough Council. The portal shows 2016-02-10 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
